claim: On one ibm_fez qubit pair (q9-q10), the vendor's headline CZ error under-states the re-derived per-layer floor 11.4x; about 2x on typical pairs
backing: python3 benchmarks/generate_proof_ledger.py (capas_quantum_physics.complete_error_budget on the row below; also benchmarks/verify_xeb_purity.py)
scope: cz, sx, T1 and T2 are the vendor's published fields; idle time (300 ns), residual ZZ (50 kHz), CZ duration and leakage are DECLARED ASSUMPTIONS, not published fields. The 11.4x is dominated by dephasing from q9's T2 = 33.9 us and scales with the assumed idle. The structured-circuit 3-10x band is Proctor (Nat. Phys. 2022), a cited range.

claim: No HOLD is a dead end: each of the 7 HOLD paths ships a constructive, machine-readable resolution

scope: check_rule_table.py replays every decision recorded across the test suite, the 1,238-input grid and the repository payloads (3,018 decisions, 931 distinct reasons, 95 of 98 rules exercised on 2026-10-14) from the table alone and matches the engine's verdict on every one. It proves the trace, not each rule's predicate.

claim: Blind self-gating corpus (Ginibre, 233 real research claims): out-of-sample bad-not-ACCEPT 17/21, good-not-REJECT 16/17; X1-3 v1 53/82, 51/63
value: X1-3 blind (v1 seal, outcomes unopened): 53/82, 51/63 | X4 (v4): 11/13, 6/7 | X5 (v6): 6/8, 10/10 | X4+X5: 17/21 [0.60-0.92], 16/17 [0.73-0.99] | replay at the frozen tags: 232/233 sealed verdicts reproduced | HOLD 6/183 (all field_absent), informative 177/183 | predictive value of pass: X1-3 42/71, X4 5/7, X5 6/8 | X4, X5 pilot-grade (< 40 bad), self-run
scope: RE-DERIVABLE BY A THIRD PARTY FROM THE PUBLIC REDACTED FILES: verdicts, outcome labels and evidence fields are public; claim texts, free-text evidence and outcome notes are published as sha256 only (unpublished paper), checkable when the paper is public. Outcomes = the project's own later corrections ('bueno' = never corrected), not an external oracle. n is small; intervals are Wilson 95%.
